description: This file defines functions and constants for executing node commands, handling various actions such as retrieving device info, notifications, location, and invoking commands via a gateway. It includes command validation, payload construction, and external utility calls.

methods.name: executeNodeCommandAction
methods.description: Executes various node commands based on the specified action, including device info, notifications, location, and invoking commands with validation and payload handling.

methods.name: invokeNodeCommandPayload
methods.description: Constructs and sends a payload to invoke a node command via the gateway, returning the payload response.
